scope: Fixed higher-capacity diagnostic, not prospective validation or production approval. All848 cases unblinded development. No post-result tuning.
representation: Exactly existing CART:75 numeric/Boolean predictors plus75 missing indicators, NaN routes left. No identity/account/rating/labels/coach fields.
feature_sampling: Uniform without replacement independently at every split.
bootstrap: Sample whole training game/normalized-before-position union components with replacement, count=number of training components. Include all groups in population. Apply sampled multiplicity to all eligible window rows of that group; never resample windows independently.
training_window_weight: (5 if negative else1)/number of eligible windows for the original move, as existing CART. Bootstrap rows are replicated by group multiplicity.
raw_leaf_probability: Raw positive bootstrap window rows / all bootstrap window rows in the leaf. No class-cost weighting in p; minleaf counts unique original moves, not replicated rows. Forest window p is arithmetic mean of64 leaf RAW p. Not calibrated.
outer_evaluation: Exactly existing five grouped outer folds in features.json. Each test fold is excluded as whole unions. Separate descriptive full-data forest.
final_award: Both window mean RAW p >=threshold AND original eligibility in both windows AND original confidence_sufficient.
case_score_for_AUC: min(current_mean_p,previous_mean_p), reported both raw and with ineligible/insufficient cases set to0. Case-level AUC, not independent-window performance.
importance: Mean per-tree normalized weighted-Gini gain, with expanded-feature and collapsed missing-indicator views. Descriptive, not causal.
